description: Multiple choice options for GHCR pull failure, with the correct answer being that new packages default to private.

steps.description: Propagation myth: GHCR requires 24-hour propagation period is false.
Latest tag myth: image tag must be latest for public pulls is false.
Answer: new GHCR packages default to private visibility and must be changed to public.
Credential myth: Docker Hub credentials interfering is false.
